The group also urged APC members and youths across the 19 northern states to withdraw support for the President’s re-election bid in the 2027 general elections.
The forum’s Secretary, Umar Chanji, stated this on behalf of the group during a press briefing in Kano on Saturday, accusing the Tinubu administration of neglecting Nigerians despite the sacrifices made by party members to secure its victory in the 2023 elections.
Chanji said the group would no longer support or promote Tinubu’s second-term ambition, alleging that the administration had failed in its responsibility to protect lives and property.
He cited persistent attacks on communities in Katsina, Sokoto, Zamfara, Niger, Plateau, Nasarawa, Benue, Kaduna, Kebbi, Bauchi and Taraba states, among others, as evidence of the worsening security situation.
According to him, thousands of villages have been affected by insecurity, forcing residents to abandon their homes, farms and schools.
The forum also criticised the Federal Government’s economic policies, particularly the removal of fuel subsidy, saying they had worsened the hardship faced by ordinary Nigerians.
It further faulted the government over alleged failure to fulfil promises on the rehabilitation of refineries and other economic interventions.
Chanji accused the administration of abandoning party loyalists who worked for its victory in 2023, alleging that political appointments had favoured individuals close to those in government at the expense of grassroots supporters.
He also expressed concern over what he described as inadequate government attention to education and healthcare, particularly in communities affected by insecurity and poverty.
However, the forum said its opposition to Tinubu’s re-election bid would not affect its support for other APC candidates in the North.
It pledged to campaign for the party’s governorship, senatorial, House of Representatives and state House of Assembly candidates across the 19 northern states in the 2027 elections.
The group, led by its chairman, Alhaji Mustapha Tinubu, urged northern APC members and youths to reject the President’s second-term ambition while remaining in the party.
